name: Pretty Flap ~Chocola Taste~
original_name: Pretty flap ～ショコラテイスト～
source:
The protagonist was panicking as she hadn't secured a job even though it was the summer of her fourth year in university. However, after many ups and downs, she secured a job at a general trade company called TMV International.

Then, just over a year later...
The protagonist had finally adjusted to her event planning work and started to have ambitions of taking her career further. That's when her boss entrusted her with a large part of a project. While she went all out and tried her best, she wasn't producing the results she aspired to.

She wondered if she was doing her job correctly.
She even started to wonder if her methods were totally wrong, and her days became filled with worries.

The one who had kindly offered a guiding hand for her was a guy she got to know well during her university days...

[Translation of official website story summary.]
translation:
主人公已经升入大学四年级，却直到夏天仍未找到工作，为此焦虑不已。经历重重波折后，她终于进入一家名为TMV International的综合贸易公司。

转眼一年多过去…
主人公终于适应了活动策划工作，也开始产生进一步发展事业的抱负。就在这时，上司把一个项目的重要部分交给了她。她竭尽全力，却始终无法取得自己期待的成果。

自己的工作方式真的正确吗？
会不会从根本上就用错了方法？她甚至开始产生这样的怀疑，每天都被烦恼包围。

就在此时，一名大学时代与她十分熟悉的男性温柔地向她伸出了援手…

[翻译自官方网站故事简介。]
